basis.version_scope: Literal retained source assignments only, not installed distribution or runtime versions.
basis.official_API_description: HEAD /containers/{id}/archive returns filesystem information in the base64 JSON X-Docker-Container-Path-Stat response header. No archive body is requested.

proposed_operations.Docker_CLI: Only two exact container inspect calls; complete raw SHA must equal retained stopped baseline before and after.
proposed_operations.Docker_socket: Only twelve fixed unversioned /containers/{id}/archive HEAD requests, two per exact path, local AF_UNIX /var/run/docker.sock; no GET or filesystem content copies. Documentation v1.51 is descriptive, not an exercised API version pin.
proposed_operations.response: Header-only HTTP/1.1 200 or404, strict unique ASCII headers, no transfer encoding/body, canonical base64 and exact five-field JSON path-stat shape. Positive name/plain regular mode/empty linkTarget/positive integer size required. Paired decoded path metadata equal.
proposed_operations.missing_path: Retain404 refusal; no fallback, guessed spelling or package import.
proposed_operations.oversized_path: Observe reported size only; content read remains unauthorized. Never raise ordinary cap.
proposed_operations.independent_readback: Separately source/invocation/resource-reviewed checker must pin actual candidate SHA, two-read every retained file with held/named physical bookends, independently reconstruct request/response/stat pairs and CLI terminals, perform one fresh exact stopped inspect. It must not repeat HEAD requests.

resources.owned_cleanup: Each socket closes in its with context; owned CLI/SSH process groups have TERM/wait/KILL/reap and retained bounded output/exit receipts. No container stop or daemon cancellation inferred.

acceptance_scope: Actual daemon-reported existence and sizes only after primary plus independent evidence; no held-FD container-source physical identity or every-file baked-image attestation. No package content, METADATA version, RECORD contents, native suffixes, installed/runtime versions, callable/global/type/dataclass/native/thread/model/RAM acceptance.
